question: Senior here, applying for fall 2026. My parents filed taxes for 2025 already, which return do they pull info from?
reference_answer: The 2026-27 FAFSA, which covers fall 2026, uses 2024 tax information, not the 2025 return. Most of it transfers directly from the IRS once each contributor gives consent.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 2: Filling Out the FAFSA Form

question: Counselor question: what's the hard federal cutoff for 2026-27 FAFSA corrections like adding a school?
reference_answer: For 2026-27, corrections, including adding schools, must be received by the FAFSA Processing System by September 11, 2027. Students should make them much earlier so schools can pay aid on time.

sources.title: 2026-2027 Award Year Deadline Dates for the FAFSA Form (Federal Register)

question: Can my older sister, who I live with, fill in the parent section for me?
reference_answer: No. Only a biological or adoptive parent, or a person the state has determined to be a parent, counts as a parent on the FAFSA. A sibling, other relative or legal guardian is not a parent unless they adopted you, so their information doesn't go in the parent section.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 2: Filling Out the FAFSA Form

question: If one of my parents skips the consent step, do I still get an SAI?
must_not_include: you will still get an SAI
reference_answer: No. If a required contributor doesn't give consent and approval, the FAFSA is rejected and no SAI is calculated. You won't be eligible for federal student aid until every required contributor provides it.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 1: The Application Process: FAFSA to ISIR

question: Born in March 2003, going to be a sophomore. Do I count as independent because of age?
must_not_include: you are independent because of your age
reference_answer: Not because of age. For 2026-27, a student is independent by age only if born before January 1, 2003, so a March 2003 birthday doesn't qualify on its own. You'd be dependent unless another independence question applies or your aid office grants an override.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 2: Filling Out the FAFSA Form

question: Does the SAI have a minimum? Can it go below zero?
reference_answer: Yes. The SAI can be negative, down to a minimum of -1,500, and the top of the range is 999,999. A lower SAI means greater financial need.

sources.title: 2026-27 Student Aid Index (SAI) and Pell Grant Eligibility Guide

question: My aid office says I owe nothing until they see my offer but my SAI is 4000. Is the 4000 what I pay?
reference_answer: No. The SAI is an index, not a bill or the amount you'll pay. Schools subtract it from their cost of attendance to estimate your financial need, and your actual cost depends on the aid offer.

sources.title: Student Aid Index (SAI) Explained

question: Parent here: my ex and I split time 50/50 and gave equal support. Which of us does the FAFSA?
must_not_include: the parent the student lives with
reference_answer: If both parents provided the same amount of support, or neither did, the parent with the greater income and assets is the one who reports on the FAFSA.

question: Do we list our retirement IRA under investments on the FAFSA?
reference_answer: No. Retirement plans such as IRAs, 401(k)s and pensions are not reported as assets on the FAFSA, though distributions from them can count as income.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 2: Filling Out the FAFSA Form

question: Our company has about 60 workers. Do I put its value on my kid's 2026-27 FAFSA?
reference_answer: For 2026-27, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act excludes the net worth of a family-owned business with 100 or fewer full-time or full-time-equivalent employees, so a business with about 60 workers isn't reported. Confirm the current instructions on StudentAid.gov.

sources.title: (APP-25-23) 2026-27 FAFSA Form and Pell Grant Eligibility Updates

question: Can I list more than 10 schools on the FAFSA?
reference_answer: Yes, online you can list up to 20 schools; the paper form allows 10. You can add more later, but with 20 already listed each new school replaces an existing one.

question: Got a notice that my FAFSA needs verification and I'm worried. If I ignore it what's the worst that happens to my Pell?
reference_answer: If you don't provide the documents by your school's deadline, you lose Pell Grant eligibility for that award year and must return any Pell money already received. The school also can't make further Direct Loans or campus-based aid.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 4: Verification, Updates, and Corrections

question: Are FAFSA verification and corrections the same thing?
reference_answer: No. Verification is when your school confirms certain FAFSA information, such as income or family size, using documents you provide; records are selected by the Department or the school. A correction is a change you or your school submits to fix an error on the FAFSA.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 4: Verification, Updates, and Corrections

question: Will I get the max Pell Grant if my SAI comes out negative?
reference_answer: I can't promise an award. A negative SAI signals high need, but your Pell Grant depends on the federal rules, your enrollment, your school's cost and your full FAFSA record. Your school's financial aid office determines your Pell award and will show it in your aid offer.

sources.title: 2026-27 FSA Handbook, Application and Verification Guide, Ch. 3: SAI and Pell Grant Eligibility

question: Our family lost a lot of income this year. Is there any way the school can take that into account?
reference_answer: Possibly. Contact your school's financial aid office and explain the change with documentation. Aid administrators can use professional judgment to adjust FAFSA data case by case for special circumstances; the FAFSA itself isn't updated for later income changes.
